description: MCP server for Google Business Profile: locations, reviews, local posts and performance metrics.
name: io.github.A1-x-Tech/mcp-google-business

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client id from Google Cloud Console (refresh flow).
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_BUSINESS_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client secret. Treat it as a secret.
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_BUSINESS_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 refresh token with the business.manage scope. Treat it as a secret.
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_BUSINESS_REFRESH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Ready-made access token (~1 h) as an alternative to the refresh-flow trio above.
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_BUSINESS_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Retries on transient errors (429 always; 5xx/network on idempotent calls).
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_BUSINESS_MAX_RETRIES

environmentVariables.description: Business Profile Performance API base override.
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_BUSINESS_PERFORMANCE_API_BASE

environmentVariables.description: Legacy v4 My Business API base override (reviews, local posts).
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_BUSINESS_V4_API_BASE

title: Google Business Profile MCP
